description: This file is a startup assembly script for a MIPS-based embedded system, specifically a header of the LZMA compressed kernel loader for Atheros AR7XXX/AR9XXX boards. It includes hardware initialization, cache configuration, relocation, BSS clearing, stack setup, and jumping to the main decompressor routine.

methods.name: startup
methods.description: Entry point of the assembly startup routine that performs CPU and memory initialization before jumping to the main decompressor.

methods.name: ehb
methods.description: Macro for execution hazard barrier in MIPS assembly to ensure instruction sequencing.
